episodes.synopsis: After their flight from the capital, Anju is poisoned, Oshtor is dead and Haku has taken his place. Now Haku must rebuild their army and protect Anju, while keep his identity secret from his friends.
episodes.title: Beside the Iron Fan

episodes.synopsis: As Kiwru and the forces of Oshtor's guard race to Ennakamuy, Haku and his new army must rush to aid them.
episodes.title: Whereabouts of Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Haku faces his first real test, as Dekopompo moves against Ennakamuy. He's bringing thousands of troops with him, and a familiar face as well...
episodes.title: Stain the Road Crimson

episodes.synopsis: Kuon wakes up back home in Tuskur, with no memory of how she got there. Remembering, though, won't help her save Haku.
episodes.title: Unrequited Love

episodes.synopsis: Haku is visited by a mysterious merchant who claims to be sent by Kuon. And Mikazuchi, the Imperial Guard of the Left, pays a visit to Ennakamuy as well...
episodes.title: Opposing Pair

episodes.synopsis: Kuon challenges Anju, who she believes to be a spoiled brat that has no right to rule Yamato.
episodes.title: Dominant Princess

episodes.synopsis: Kuon does her best to batter Anju into submission so that she'll remain in Ennakamuy instead of trying to retake Yamato.
episodes.title: Speaking to a Princess

episodes.synopsis: Kuon comes back to Ennakamuy, this time as the friend they all love and know.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: The party travels to Rulutieh's homeland, where one member of her family doesn't want her to leave.
episodes.title: The One Who Bears the Flute

episodes.synopsis: The party goes to visit Nosuri's home, where one of the Eight Pillar Generals wants to ally with them.
episodes.title: Forest of Schemes

episodes.synopsis: Tokifusa corners the party in the Great Canyon near Ennakamuy and tries to kill them to get back the Golden Seal.
episodes.title: Proof of a Ruler

episodes.synopsis: In their battle to liberate Nakoku, the party finds themselves against a foe they never expected to face.
episodes.title: Flames of Dark Obsession

episodes.synopsis: With Nakoku safe, the party heads home to Ennakamuy for the next stage of the war.
episodes.title: A Vow to Rebuild

episodes.synopsis: The party takes a breather before the final battle begins for control of Yamato.
episodes.title: The Night Before the Final Battle

episodes.synopsis: As the battle with Raiko and the forces of the court begins, Haku will have to do whatever it takes to survive their onslaught.
episodes.title: Slim Chance of Survival

episodes.synopsis: Haku battles Mikazuchi as their armies clash on the plains before the capital city.
episodes.title: Legends Clash

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Haku and the court's forces comes to a shocking conclusion.
episodes.title: The Price of Resolve

episodes.synopsis: The Yamato civil war comes to an end as Raiko makes one last stand.
episodes.title: With a Great Wish in One's Heart

episodes.synopsis: With the civil war over, Haku is tasked with setting out on a new journey.
episodes.title: The Role Left to Me

episodes.synopsis: Haku heads to Tuskur, where he meets the princess of the kingdom.
episodes.title: To Tuskur

episodes.synopsis: The truth behind the Master Key is revealed.
episodes.title: Humanity's Heir

episodes.synopsis: Woshis steals the Master Key and attempts to use it for his own ends.
episodes.title: The Door to Wisdom

episodes.synopsis: Woshis's drive to attain ultimate wisdom comes at a terrible price for the whole world.
episodes.title: In the Land of Awakenings

episodes.synopsis: Haku races to stop eternal winter from befalling on the world just as a new threat arises.
episodes.title: A Voice from the Abyss

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected ally appears to save Haku and his friends from the Noroi.
episodes.title: Twisted Onkami

episodes.synopsis: Woshis makes a last attempt to grab power and end the world.
episodes.title: The End of a Wish

episodes.synopsis: Haku is forced to make a final decision as Woshis clings to power.
episodes.title: Start of a Myth

episodes.synopsis: Haku is gone, and his friends go to search for him.
episodes.title: Mask of Truth
